# wso2is_role (Data Source)

Looks up a role by ID or name, for example the built-in `admin` or `everyone` role. When you look up an application role by name, also set `audience_id`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "wso2is_role" "admin" {
  name = "admin"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `audience_id` (String) Organization or application ID the role belongs to (narrows a name lookup).
- `id` (String) Role ID.
- `name` (String) Role name.

### Read-Only

- `audience_type` (String) `organization` or `application`.
- `permissions` (Set of String) Scopes granted by the role.
